scope: Exercise the installed GTK2 DomainOS endpoint painter in a private Xvfb against the user-selected GTK2 palette bundle; verify all arrow state assets, endpoint-vs-widget-insensitive distinction, and blocked input.

method.fixture: R686 native GtkHScrollbar/GtkVScrollbar input fixture, run with private HOME, copied user DomainOS GTK2 theme, current generated role assets and a fresh build of the exact installed engine source.
method.captures: Four directions: initial normal, hover, pressed, released-hover, lower/upper endpoints, and whole-widget-insensitive. Crop each 15x15 stepper at 1:1.
method.input: Simulate press/release at each blocked physical endpoint and compare adjustment values before, held, and after release.

results.endpoint_policy: All four range-endpoint cells render the normal palette asset.
results.whole_widget_insensitive: All four cells render their disabled palette assets.

conclusion: The user-installed DomainOS GTK2 engine distinguishes a blocked AUTO stepper at the range boundary from a wholly insensitive GtkRange. It displays the palette-derived normal stepper at blocked endpoints without changing adjustment/input behavior; a wholly insensitive range still uses the disabled-role assets. All exercised state crops match their corresponding generated GTK2 assets exactly.
limits: This is a private GTK2 test against generated palette assets, not a direct comparison of historical endpoint/disabled behavior in Domain/OS SR10.4/VUE.
The generated assets came from the current profile bundle; no real KDE scheme transition or production observer event was triggered.
No user application, desktop setting, VM, theme selection, or other toolkit family was changed.
Hover, whole-widget-insensitive historical VUE appearance, thumb drag, direct VUE arrow input, and user visual acceptance remain open; I517 remains separate.
next: Continue only I167/GTK2. Safely isolate the observer palette event path so it refreshes GTK2 only; keep the real KDE scheme, GTK4, desktop and running applications untouched. Historical pointer input to VUE remains gated by I517.
